recommended_trials.rationale: Insertion feasibility and scoring is a central ALNS repair cost. Reuse deterministic insertion options for the same immutable route and task within a solve; confirm exact decision equivalence with fixed iterations, and only then test equal wall budgets.
recommended_trials.risk: Cache key omissions or retaining insufficient options can change decisions. Includes route, task/leg, route/home identity, candidate limit and top_k; bounded eviction limits memory.

recommended_trials.rationale: A K-step geometric schedule reaches the final temperature at the planned search end; the baseline fixed .995 decay reaches its floor after 817 iterations regardless of total budget. Try T=T_start*(T_end/T_start)^p with p=completed/total iterations for iteration budget, or elapsed/available search time for wall budget.
recommended_trials.risk: Longer high-temperature exploration may waste scarce seconds or worsen each seed; no guarantee. Keep the canonical lexicographic incumbent and compare independently to the baseline.

future_leads.proposal: Adjacent-string removal over selected neighboring routes plus bounded randomized insertion (blinks), adapted to remove both visits of every selected pickup-delivery task. Equal per-route removals can open multiple slots under M*K=N.
future_leads.warning: Existing route_segment is one-route removal; this is a different multi-route neighborhood. Precise publication algorithm has not been reimplemented from full text.
